purpose: Cover-production contract for Rex Fleet. The exact released Issue 1 Green Corridor cover is persisted locally as the masthead/trade-dress pixel reference; Issues 2-12 use that image only for recurring cover-brand continuity while their own assembled RexPrompt cover recipes control issue-specific imagery.

foundingCover.rule: Issue 1 is released canon. Do not regenerate, redraw or replace it unless the user explicitly reopens the cover.

controls: Star Splitter Visions mark treatment and placement
gold divider and THREE POWERS. ONE FRONTIER. tagline treatment

pixelReadGate.rule: Before generating any later Rex Fleet cover, retrieve and visually inspect the actual pixels from the local approved Issue 1 cover reference in active multimodal context. A path, SHA, metadata record, textual description, memory, or statement that the image was previously viewed does not satisfy this gate.
pixelReadGate.blockedBehavior: If the approved Issue 1 cover pixels cannot be retrieved and visually inspected, stop before later-cover generation rather than recreating the trade dress from text.

recipeAuthority.rule: The assembled current cover recipe controls the issue-specific selling image, cast, setting, composition, focal hierarchy, thumbnail read, spoiler ceiling, exact required cover lettering and issue-specific visual emphasis. The Issue 1 pixel reference controls only recurring cover-brand appearance at the scope above.
recipeAuthority.conflictResolution: If copying Issue 1 composition would conflict with the current cover recipe, follow the current cover recipe and preserve only the scoped trade-dress continuity.

coverRules: One dominant selling idea per issue.
The cover must work at thumbnail size before fine detail is readable.
No generic cast lineup unless the current issue recipe explicitly requires an ensemble composition.
No superhero posing when the issue's dramatic engine is procedural, political, civic, scientific or intimate.
No invented environmental text or fake signage.
Only exact required cover lettering from the assembled recipe may be rendered.
Do not reveal the issue's decisive solution, late reversal, winner, death, signature, or final image beyond the explicit spoiler ceiling.
Use established Rex Fleet faction, ship, character, corridor and anomaly visual canon from the normal production reference workflow in addition to the cover trade-dress reference.
